Blast him!|This droid and a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 4 (Rugosa)|fellow droid]] noticing Yoda|}} A '''B1 battle droid''' served in the [[Separatist Droid Army|droid army]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. They were stationed on [[Rugosa]] during a [[Battle of Rugosa|battle]] as part of [[Asajj Ventress]]' forces. {{Droid-stub}} ==Biography== In [[22 BBY]], This [[battle droid]] was sent out with a ground team to find [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]]. After a [[Unidentified B1 battle droid 4 (Rugosa)|fellow droid]] noticed Yoda, this droid told his companions to shoot at the Jedi and then to split up into [[squad]]s. The entire group was eventually cut down by Yoda. ==Characteristics== Like all [[B1-series battle droid|B1 battle droids]], they stood at 1.93 [[meter]]s tall. They sported [[bone]]-[[Color|white]] colored plating and was equipped with an [[E-5 blaster rifle]]. ==Behind the scenes== His first and only appearance was in "[[Ambush]]," the first episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]], which originally aired on [[October 3]], [[2008]]. They were voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}} ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Ambush}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]]
